我们之前研发的虚空诱饵吸引了一群来自其他恒星系的太空鲸鱼，这些恒星系类似[This.Capital.System.GetName]，均含有气态巨行星。

看来我们的设备必须在这些环境中建造才能正常工作。如果我们发现其他野生动物，我们应该也能在它们的自然栖息地附近建造虚空诱饵。
texts.en:
The Voidlure we had previously developed attracted a group of space whales native to systems with Gas Giants akin to [This.Capital.System.GetName].

It seems our devices must be built in those environments to work properly. Should we discover other wild fauna, we should be able to construct Voidlures near their natural habitats as well.
